_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Pod Master Event Spectrum (MES)
summary: Describes the analysis of repeated loads experienced on the pod's structure, used to verify the pod's ability to meet durability, damage tolerance, and operational service life requirements specified in the contract.
use_relationship:
The Pod Master Event Spectrum describes the analysis of the effects from repeated loads experienced on the pod's structure. The data will be used to verify the pod's ability to meet the durability, damage tolerance, and operational service life requirements specified in the contract.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content for data resulting from the work tasks described by the contract statement of work.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-82266.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Pod MES shall contain the following:

children.title: Describe the aircraft MES that forms the basis
children.content: Describe the aircraft MES that forms the basis for the pod MES. The aircraft Master Event Spectrum (MES) is a profile of specific sequences and number of aircraft occurrences that reflect the fatigue exposure of the pod over a lifetime. It includes events such as taxis, takeoffs, flight maneuvers, and landings that are specific to a particular aircraft and set of missions.

children.title: Describe pod specific modifications and additions
children.content: Describe pod specific modifications and additions to the aircraft MES used to create the pod MES. Define the pod coordinate system and show how the aircraft MES is translated to the pod coordinated system. Define any factors beyond simple geometric translation that define the conversion of the aircraft MES to the pod MES, e.g. structural dynamic effects between the aircraft MES reference location and the pod MES reference location. Define pod specific events that alter loads in terms of sequence, duration, and number of occurrences, such as drag increase due to power generation or external surface actuations, or any pod event that alters external loads from the basic aircraft carriage loads.

children.title: Describe the external loads time histories for each
children.content: Describe the external loads time histories for each event in the pod MES. Include the reference coordinate system, six degree-of-freedom (6DOF) loads and accelerations, inertial and air loads, quasi-static shock loads, and any dynamic buffeting occurring.

children.title: Describe methods and analytical tools used to
children.content: Describe methods and analytical tools used to perform the analysis, including rain flow counting methodology and any filters used to reduce or eliminate events from the pod MES.
